item.text: [{"task_id":"e4941b18","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    block = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    red = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    blue = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    step = int(round(params['step'][0]))","    out = grid.copy()","    blocks = np.argwhere(grid == block)","    reds = np.argwhere(grid == red)","    blues = np.argwhere(grid == blue)","    if len(blocks) == 0 or len(reds) != 1 or len(blues) != 1:","        return out","    rr, rc = reds[0]","    br, bc = blues[0]","    bottom = int(np.max(blocks[:, 0]))","    if bc > rc:","        side = int(np.max(blocks[:, 1])) + step","    else:","        side = int(np.min(blocks[:, 1])) - step","    if side < 0 or side >= grid.shape[1]:","        return out","    out[rr, rc] = background","    out[br, bc] = red","    out[bottom, side] = blue","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"step":[1]},"params":{"colors":[7,5,2,8],"step":[1]},"rationale":"Red moves to blue's original position.
